Chapter 1150: 15: Treasure Land Everywhere (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1150: Chapter 15: Treasure Land Everywhere (Seeking Subscription)_2

Secondly, there’s the “Xuanhuang Crystal”.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm is half-integrated with the universe’s time and space, exchanging Chaos Qi with the outside, able to continuously nurture new Xuanhuang Crystals.

But the earlier-than-expected Great Collapse of the home universe came too soon; normally, the time within a complete Cosmic Era would be enough for the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to nurture Xuanhuang Crystals sufficient for Lin Yuan to refine to the Chaos Realm level of “Xuanhuang Physique”.

Even if not achieving Chaos Realm Perfection, one could still wait for the next Cosmic Era, the era after that, and slowly accumulate.

For a being at the Chaos Realm level, waiting ten Cosmic Eras, a hundred Cosmic Eras isn’t a difficult task.

Due to the premature Great Collapse of the home universe, Lin Yuan lost the stable source of acquiring Xuanhuang Crystals.

After refining the “Xuanhuang Physique” to Dominator Realm perfection, this method of body refinement stagnated, not because resources couldn’t keep up, but because Xuanhuang Crystals couldn’t keep up.

“If I could face thousands more of these Xuanhuang Beasts, I’d probably be able to refine the “Xuanhuang Physique” to the Chaos Realm level.”

Lin Yuan stored the kilometer-sized Xuanhuang Crystal, estimating inwardly.

His body’s starting point is too high, even just refining the “Xuanhuang Physique” to Dominator Realm perfection means his physical strength rivals the normal Chaos Great Saints.

Once he pushes the “Xuanhuang Physique” to the Chaos Realm level, his bodily strength will likely reach the peak level of the Chaos Great Saints.

If the “Xuanhuang Physique” is refined to Chaos Realm perfection, mere physical strength alone could suppress peerless Great Saints.

“Thousands?”

Lin Yuan gazed toward the four directions of the starry sky, not feeling that it’s too many.

The Xuanhuang Universe is vast, and its nurturing of Xuanhuang Beasts definitely far exceeds tens of thousands.

“There are quite a few Venerables entering the universe this time; eventually, I can exchange for the Xuanhuang Crystals they have.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

He can encounter Xuanhuang Beasts, and other Chaos Realm individuals will likely encounter them as well.

The Xuanhuang Beasts cannot leave the world they are in, and upon death, their physical bodies and souls will collapse, leaving only the Xuanhuang Crystals.

Moreover, Xuanhuang Crystals only hold significant value for the strong members of the Profound Xuanhuang.

If they fall into the hands of other creatures? At most, they would equate to Chaos Stones of equal size; Lin Yuan only needs to offer a bit of premium in exchange, and those Chaos Realm Venerables would surely scramble to get in line.

…

Next.

Every time Lin Yuan traverses, he keeps an eye out to see if there are any Xuanhuang Beasts nearby.

If there are, he eliminates them conveniently and takes the Xuanhuang Crystal; if not, he doesn’t force it and traverses with full effort along the planned route.

It’s not that Xuanhuang Crystals aren’t valuable, concerning Lin Yuan’s body refinement strength, Xuanhuang Crystals are naturally important.

But so far, Xuanhuang Crystals are only effective for him, so even if Lin Yuan doesn’t specifically seek them out, other Chaos Venerables won’t focus all their energy on Xuanhuang Beasts.

Defeating a single Xuanhuang Beast at the Chaos Realm threshold isn’t easy for Chaos Realm peak Venerables; it involves an arduous battle, resulting only in acquiring tens of thousands of Chaos Stones or hundreds of thousands?

To those outside the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, Xuanhuang Crystals are equivalent to the same amount of Chaos Stones.

…

“It’s here.”

Lin Yuan descended in front of a pale green planet, observing it meticulously.

This pale green planet doesn’t emit the slightest breath, appearing no different from the lifeless planets within the Xuanhuang Universe.

Yet on the beast skin map, this pale green planet is marked as the Life Origin Star, the place where Life Divine Stones are nurtured.

The Life Divine Stone is a cosmic treasure from the Chaos Void; a palm-sized Life Divine Stone contains enough Life Source Power to heal a gravely injured Chaos Great Saint in a short period.

Even if suffering some irreversible harm, as long as the Life Source Power within the Life Divine Stone isn’t exhausted, one won’t die.

Because of this, Life Divine Stones have always been highly prized yet not available for sale within the Chaos Void, considered the top tier of life-saving items, eagerly sought by Chaos Great Saints.

“Life Divine Stones are peculiar treasures fallen from the Sea of Life, and the Sea of Life, like the light pools, are mysterious places within the Chaos Void, normally inaccessible.”

“Theoretically, only the Sea of Life can drop Life Divine Stones, and their numbers are extremely rare, but that’s only theory.”

Lin Yuan looked at the pale green planet not far away.

Why would peerless Great Saints expend effort to create a Postnatal Universe? Precisely because the Postnatal Universe created by peerless Great Saints allows them to set their own rules.

For instance, this Life Origin Star was nurtured by His Majesty Xuanhuang to mimic the Sea of Life, capable of evolving Life Divine Stones.

Of course, the Life Origin Star guided and nurtured by His Majesty Xuanhuang falls far short of the true Sea of Life, and its efficiency in birthing Life Divine Stones isn’t as high as the Sea of Life.

But over tens of millions of Cosmic Eras, even if the Life Origin Star’s efficiency in nurturing Life Divine Stones is low, with no one having taken them away for such a long time, quite a few Life Divine Stones must have accumulated?

“Let’s go see.”

Lin Yuan split off an avatar to enter the Life Origin Star.

Even though the beast skin map’s introduction to the Life Origin Star is that it’s not dangerous, Lin Yuan was reluctant to enter personally.

Who knows what changes might have occurred inside the Life Origin Star over such a long period?

Inside the Life Origin Star, Lin Yuan’s avatar quickly descended, heading straight to the core.

“Hmm?”

Here, life energy converged at the core, spreading like mist around, and Lin Yuan thought to himself that in this environment, no matter how grave an injury, rapid recovery seemed assured.

“What’s that?”

Lin Yuan gazed towards the deepest point, noticing a green crystal nearly three meters in size, quietly floating in the ocean of life energy, from which all pervasive mist originated.

“A Life Divine Stone?”

“A Life Divine Stone nearly three meters in size?”

Lin Yuan was stunned; a palm-sized Life Divine Stone could rapidly heal a Chaos Great Saint at the brink of death, and now this Life Divine Stone is nearly three meters?

Equivalent to tens of thousands of palm-sized Life Divine Stones?

Capable of saving tens of thousands of gravely injured Chaos Great Saints?

“With such a large Life Divine Stone, even if attacked by a group of peerless Great Saints, I wouldn’t die quickly.” Lin Yuan rejoiced inwardly.

As long as the Life Source Power within the Chaos Divine Stone remained, Lin Yuan could be considered immortal, which far exceeds the Physical Body Divine Ability’s ‘rebirth from a drop of blood’.

Unless a thirteenth level life entity intervenes, erasing Lin Yuan from the temporal plane, no one could kill him instantly.

“How much would this be worth in Chaos Stones?”

Lin Yuan calmed himself; to be accurate, no amount of Chaos Stones could replace a Life Divine Stone, the latter being the top tier life-saving item even for Chaos Great Saints.

“Collect.”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan began collecting the Life Divine Stone.

Rumbling.

The entire Life Origin Star shook, and Lin Yuan, standing outside, began to assist, aiding the avatar in collecting the Life Divine Stone.

Eventually, the Life Divine Stone, nearly three meters in size, slowly fell into Lin Yuan’s hands.

“I’ve hit the jackpot.”

Lin Yuan felt jubilant; this expedition to the Xuanhuang Universe, even without other gains, solely this Life Divine Stone sufficed to make up for it.

“Life Divine Stone isn’t just the top tier life-saving item, its core lies in the Life Origin Rules contained within, which is crucial for me to comprehend life-related rules and pathways.”

Lin Yuan carefully stored the Life Divine Stone within his cosmic body, allocated some focus merely observing for a short while but already achieving insight.

“No rush for now.”

“Ready to collect the next treasure.”

Once confirming no other Life Divine Stones were left on the Life Origin Star, having removed the Life Divine Stone, the life mist pervading the star quickly dissipated.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished, appearing tens of millions of light-years away.

Subsequently, Lin Yuan followed the planned route track, traversing regions where treasures and wonders were stored, collecting them effortlessly.

Great Saint level weapon secret treasures?

Exceedingly rare wonders across tens of thousands of Cosmic Eras?

Heavy treasures only nurtured by specific mysterious places in the Chaos Void?

The wealth Lin Yuan amassed along his journey would incite envy and madness from peerless Great Saints.

The resources accumulated by the Xuanhuang Universe over millions of epochs became a windfall for Lin Yuan.
